specification: specs/proposals/d2-profiles.md (to become specs/d2-profiles.json on Director approval; SHA-256 of the spec and of the five Part B artifacts pending, not yet computed)
oldBehavior: 0-D only: total electron/ion thermal energies and one common particle inventory evolve; no radial profile is solved (A-M01-004). Losses are W/tauE and N/tauP with illustrative closures; sources carry no radial deposition (A-M01-006/007); bremsstrahlung and Ohmic power are volume totals (A-M01-008); the ledger is scalar (A-M01-013).
newBehavior: When explicitly enabled through a separate optional options value: flux-surface-averaged 1-D diffusion of n, w_e, w_i on rho in [0,1] (rho = volume-normalised radius, V'(rho)=2 V rho, V = 0.1.0 Geometry.volume; metric closure <|grad rho|^2> = 1/L^2, L^2 = V/(2 pi^2 R0)) with prescribed scalar D, chi_e, chi_i; every 0.1.0 source total distributed by a normalised prescribed shape; zero flux at the axis and a prescribed edge flux equal to the 0-D losses N/tauP, We/tauE, Wi/tauE. The 0-D loop stays authoritative and unchanged (passenger coupling), so profile integrals equal the 0-D N, We, Wi to 1e-9 relative. A new explicit 'profile constraint violated' stop is added. When not enabled: behaviour, outputs and modelVersion '0.1.0' are bit-for-bit unchanged.

proposedAssumptionChanges.change: Still active and exact for the profile-off path. When profiles are enabled, radial profiles of n, T_e, T_i are evolved as a constrained passenger of the 0-D totals; totals remain 0-D. Recommended: keep the ID active, add scope note; register new A-D2-* IDs rather than redefine.
Unchanged 0.1.0 closures. New illustrative closures added under proposed IDs A-D2-*: scalar D, chi_e, chi_i and source-shape parameters.
Fractions and totals unchanged; the 'no deposition' clause is superseded only when profiles are enabled, by prescribed illustrative deposition shapes (no orbit, resonance or fast-ion model).
Efficiency, prompt ionization and cold gas unchanged; gas and ionization cost distributed edge-locally by rho^m.
Bremsstrahlung total unchanged; local distribution follows n^2 sqrt(T_e), renormalised to the 0-D total each step.
W/tauE remains the effective total loss; when profiles are enabled it is applied as the edge conductive flux. No separate advective term added.
Scalar ledger unchanged; a radial per-species ledger and integral-parity check are added for profile-on runs.
Existing unsupported statuses unchanged; a distinct profile-constraint-violated status is added (non-positive n, T_e or T_i in any cell; never clipped).

proposedNewAssumptionIds: A-D2-001 volume-normalised radius and V'=2 V rho
A-D2-003 scalar prescribed D, chi_e, chi_i (illustrative)
A-D2-004 conductive-only energy flux, no separate advection
A-D2-005 prescribed illustrative source shapes normalised to 0-D totals
A-D2-006 edge flux equals 0-D loss (integral constraint), passenger coupling, no profile feedback
A-D2-008 profile pressure not fed to, and not reconciled with, the Solovev pressure
unchangedConstants: All C-M01-* constants and the confinement scaling are unchanged and unedited; no constant is tuned for 0-D/1-D consistency.
units: SI internally; n [m^-3], w [J m^-3], T [keV], D and chi [m^2/s], edge fluxes as N/tauP [s^-1] and W/tauE [W]; export units unchanged (1e19 m^-3, keV).
versionNote: Additive. A profile-off run is the 0.1.0 model and still reports modelVersion '0.1.0'; a profile-on run reports '0.2.0'. Verification-version bump left to the Director.
rationale: M03 headline capability D2: core-versus-edge profiles as a new observable, with the existing 0-D balances kept as the integral constraint rather than a competing model. Passenger coupling was chosen so that enabling profiles cannot change any accepted 0.1.0 output, and so equilibrium input, unsupported statuses and the M01 baseline remain untouched.
evidenceAndLimits: Constructed from the 0.1.0 source code and hand derivations only; no external source was read in Part A. Coefficient values, deposition shapes and the flat initial condition are illustrative and uncalibrated; NBI/ECH shapes come from a research note with no primary source identified. Feasibility indications (edge collapse for chi below about 1.25 at D=0.1; all-zero-auxiliary corner fails at chi=3) come from a throwaway scratchpad prototype that is not repository evidence. Parity with the 0-D balances holds by construction and verifies implementation consistency, not physical accuracy. Experimentally unvalidated.
conservationAndDimensionalChecks: Discrete volume integrals of the three equations reduce term-for-term to the 0-D Euler update when shapes are normalised on the discrete cell volumes and edge fluxes equal N/tauP, We/tauE, Wi/tauE. Axis flux is exactly zero (V'(0)=0). Dimensional check: D/L^2 in s^-1, (3/2) KEV n chi/L^2 dT/drho in W m^-3 after the 1/V' divergence, V' in m^3.
expectedImpact: Profile-off: none (bit-for-bit). Profile-on: new optional 'profiles' output block; possible explicit failure where the prescribed edge loss cannot be carried by the chosen chi (e.g. chi below about 1.25 at D=0.1 on the default shot).
affectedTests: all existing tests/ and python/tests/ must stay unchanged and passing (AC-1)
M02 frozen regression fixtures and experiments/baseline/m01-shot.json (bit-for-bit, profile off)
